answer: For timber unloading at a harbor, sell time slots at prices fixed before bids arrive, with no account discounts or losing-bid rebates. An agent called zephyr may submit through a thousand aliases, but each reserved slot requires full payment and the slot ledger prevents double booking. Alias bids cannot move the price or create free reservations; extra capacity costs the same whoever buys it. This removes the payoff from false-name price manipulation, though a wealthy buyer can still hoard slots and fixed prices may allocate capacity inefficiently.
